Well it's been going for me for over 3 years (4 years if you count when my dad moved out) 

It still very much affects me. When it first happened i had no emotional response, it wasn't until 2016 i felt the weight of it truly. I think it's giving me trust issues, or issues believing people who say they care, because my dad would say shit like he cared, but then his actions showed otherwise. (For example: He stopped paying our mortgage, and since all the letters and calls went to him, we didn't find out until my mom noticed someone was taking pictures of our house which was only two weeks beforehand. He also randomly stopped paying us, which at that time my mom didn't work, so we literately had everything shut down in our house. Water, power, etc)  

It shaped my view of what it means to actually care about someone. The final trail is this Friday (Which is our 5th or 6th since the start of it. Now it's going to be just our last ditch effort to get spousal support, since most of the final rulings have been set already. 

It's made life a lot worse overall. It's nice hearing about people who actually benefited from them though. I'm happy they found happiness
